_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: findings add
cli_commands.description: Add a citation-backed finding (--claim CLAIM [--confidence C] [--citations url|title,...])

cli_commands.name: findings flag
cli_commands.description: Flag a finding as disputed (--reason REASON)

cli_commands.name: disputes resolve
cli_commands.description: Resolve a disputed finding (--resolution keep|supersede [--replacement ID] [--reason R])

cli_commands.name: findings count
cli_commands.description: Count findings captured in a time window (--window WINDOW); the canonical measure

cli_commands.name: search
cli_commands.description: Live web search (QUERY [--limit N] [--synthesis]); L0 results with optional L1 snippet synthesis

cli_commands.name: research l2
cli_commands.description: L2 fetch-read-synthesize (QUERY [--top-n N] [--capture]); full-page cited synthesis

cli_commands.name: research l3
cli_commands.description: Start an L3 iterative research-and-reconcile run (QUERY)

cli_commands.name: disputes list
cli_commands.description: List disputed findings (the dispute review queue)
